system: ASCII grid map format and parser (Cabana Republic)
what: Cabana Republic is drawn as a 41 x 29 ASCII grid of 10 m cells, one character per cell for road, crate, building, barracks, silo, tech point and harvest field. parseGridToMapDef turns that grid into the same map-definition object buildMap uses. Team comes from which half of the grid a cell is in, and the spawn and resupply points are placed 15 m and 7 m from the friendly barracks, toward the centre. Crate cells carry a 'warm' tint flag, alternated by (r+c)&1, which buildMap turns into one of two crate materials. DM_Cabana is also the game's hard-wired default map: the harvester field, tech-box pool and silo pool are seeded from it at load, placeObjectives falls back to its field, tech points and silos when a map lacks them, boot builds it unless ?map=tri, and the editor's Reset rebuilds it.

No perf figure recorded. grep at 48ffb51: DM_Cabana is read at game:704, 707, 744, 750, 973, 3189 and editor:1101; game:626 picks crateMatWarm when o.warm. Mismatch: the editor's Reset button tooltip says 'Clear the map back to empty' (index.html:1058, editor.html:1059) but the handler rebuilds DM_Cabana (shamble-editor.js:1101).
v2_note: Keep the idea that a compact authoring form compiles to one map document. Avoid: only two teams (team = which grid half), the legacy team ids 'friend' and 'hostile' (translated in game:516), objective glyphs for silos and tech boxes, which uplinks replace (LOOP_V2 §4), and no entity IDs. In v2 the map is versioned JSON with stable IDs (EDITOR_V2 §2 rule 1), and a v1 map loads through a migration (EDITOR_V2 §4). A tool outside the game (tools/village.py) depends on the exact source text of this constant. The implicit default map must not carry over: a v2 map document states every objective itself, validation should reject a map that lacks one (a recommendation: EDITOR_V2 §3 makes objectives data and lists a validation panel of reachability, the 6 m gap rule, symmetry and budgets, but names no missing-objective check yet), and nothing silently falls back to a built-in map. The crate tint flag is look data (the colours wait for the look brief); the migration keeps it only as a cosmetic variant field.
reason: EDITOR_V2 §2 rule 1 replaces the grid with a versioned JSON document, and LOOP_V2 §4 replaces the O/X silo and tech-box objectives with uplinks.

system: Cabana map content: spawn-side platforms and ramps, and the village pass
what: An inline function adds three stepped platforms (1.2, 2.5 and 4 m) beside the friendly spawn and two ramps up to the 2.5 m and 4 m platforms, plus a ramp onto the roof of the friendly base building with the lowest roof (the refinery, 4 m). The village pass is plain data: 11 houses, 70 trees, 36 props and 10 cover runs, designed as the left half and mirrored for team symmetry. The parser also writes Cabana's environment block (fog from 260 to 760 m) into the map, which map load hands to the shared environment code.

system: Procedural canvas skins and the BK texture cache
what: Ten functions each paint a 256 x 256 canvas texture (half-timber, terracotta tile, plaster, thatch, brick-and-flint, brick, slate, drystone, hedge leaves, dirt) with nearest filtering and repeat wrapping. BK.tex caches one shared copy per skin, with that skin's repeat.
where: shamble-core.js:987 genTimberTex · 1009 genTileTex · 1049 genPlasterTex · 1056 genThatchTex · 1104 genBrickFlintTex · 1265 _bkBrickTex · 1271 _bkSlateTex · 1279 _bkStoneTex · 1286 _bkHedgeTex · 1291 _bkDirtTex · 1321-1327 BK.tex (cache _tex, repeat table)
evidence: reports/2026-10-14-editor-undo-ground.md: the manor framing differs from run to run on both builds (unseeded house textures; 'house-textures-seeded' is queued, low priority, STATUS:30). Same report, PERF-2 (deferred, STATUS.md:97): _disposeObj3D disposes the shared cached BK textures; houses and covers already did on base, and trees and props now add the well roof's tile texture, so r128 re-uploads it next frame (1 extra 256 x 256 upload per rebuild; editor-undo-ground.md:51-53). ART_DIRECTION.md:127 and TECHNICAL.md:250: the brick-and-flint banding reads as 'candy stripes'. Code read: the legacy makers call genXTex() directly rather than BK.tex, so the 10 non-manor Cabana houses build 20 textures of their own.
v2_note: Keep the technique: no external assets, painted procedurally, cached once per skin. Fix in v2: seed every painter (9 of the 10 use Math.random; genTileTex, core:1009-1022, is already deterministic; the kit already has _mulberry32) so renders and A/B shots are exact. Route every caller through the cache. Never dispose cached textures on teardown. NearestFilter, the 256 px size and the palettes are look choices, so they wait for the look brief.
reason: Client-side procedural builders worth keeping in shape (code technique only, appearance pending).

what: Five roof shapes built as non-indexed geometry, so every face gets a flat normal for crisp cel shading: gable (with a shifted ridge for saltbox), hip, half-hip, and gambrel. _roofFor turns the ridge to run along the building's longer side and adds the overhangs.
v2_note: Keep the shapes and the long-axis orientation rule (it fixed deep buildings that came out turned the wrong way and hip roofs that collapsed into pyramids). They port directly to three.js BufferGeometry under WebGPU. The flat-normal choice depends on the shading model in the look brief. Roofs are not in collision or line of sight today (see CM13); a true 3D sim (VISION_V2 §6.2) will need roof volumes or walkable roofs.
reason: Client procedural geometry with no gameplay rule in it.

system: Building kit schema, presets and seeded roll

reason: Static collision volumes belong to the authoritative v2 simulation.
